large_guidance:
- Keep the structure (fused GEMM+bias+scale, then BN stats, then BN apply) but fuse the BN apply with the GEMM epilogue is not possible (needs cross-row reduction); instead, fuse `bn_stats` into the GEMM by having the GEMM kernel atomically accumulate per-column sum and sum-of-squares into workspace buffers — eliminates a full re-read of the M×N activation.
- Alternative: split-K GEMM writing partial tiles, then a single persistent kernel that reads each column tile once, does the two-pass mean/var reduction in registers, and writes the normalized output — so the M×N tensor is read once and written once for the BN portion instead of three passes (stats-read, apply-read, apply-write).
- For eval mode, fold `running_mean`, `running_var`, `bn.weight`, `bn.bias`, and `self.scale` into a single (effective_scale, effective_bias) pair at parameter-update time and apply purely in the GEMM epilogue — collapses BN entirely into the GEMM store. Training mode still needs the stats kernel.
